Hello, Artists!
The wait is over.
[i]SOUNDART[/i] v1.4.0 is now officially available!

[b]Update details[/b]

[*] New Stage "NECTAR" and "CANDY" added.

[list]
[*] Unity and other plugins updated.
[*] Adjusted the color change of stages to produce more beautiful results.
[*] Adjusted avatar movement to be more natural.
[*] Adjusted camera angles.
[*] Changed system so inputs are not registered while loading in music files. This is to prevent bugs occurring.
[*] Changed the VRM file loading to search for files that exist in the folder rather than searching for a specific file name.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the screen goes dark in first person mode under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed the bug where the bokeh effect before starting play was only working for the auto camera.
[*] Fixed the UI bug that occurs when you start a game with the stage color settings still open.

notes.title: Build v1.1.2 (beta) Update.
notes.content:
Dear Artists!
Thank you for all of the helpful feedback on the previous update.

There were a lot of comments on the distance between the sticks and the Flower.

The previous distance increased the distance between the sticks and the flower in the hopes that the Notes would be more visible, however this has resulted in an increase in miss hits.

Saying that, there are a lot of comments saying the Notes are indeed easier to follow now so we are looking for an effective middle ground between the two issues.

To gather user feedback on this we will be holding an open beta to see how you, the users, feel. You can join in by selecting the “openBeta” option from the beta tab  in properties.

We look forward to your comments regarding Note visibility and the sense of distance from the stick to the Flower.

[h3]build1.1.2 beta1[/h3]

[b]Update Details：[/b]
[list]
[*] Brought Note spawn point closer.
[*] Notes now spiral as they approach.
[*] Reduced Note size some slightly.
[*] Brought the Note hit position in towards the center.
[*] Reduced overall Note speed.
[*] Reduced Flower size slightly and brought it closer to the player.
[*] Changed the “thrust” Note design.

Taking in all the comments and recommendations from you all after launch, we decided it was better to release a bigger update instead of releasing a series of small patches.

notes.title: VR Rhythm Game SoundArt released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/098486e02d1e5d334133ab871585beec0882c8f0.jpg[/img]

Dear Fans,

Mercury Studio, a one man studio which created the popular battle racing games Break Arts and Break Arts II is back with SoundArt, a brand new title!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/804e2609c6524af14d3260fbfb77aa27f5724a36.png[/img]

[h3][b]Exhilirating Rhythm Action[/b][/h3]
Hit, sweep and thrust the blocks that come flying towards you in time with the music.
Maneuver your sticks gracefully and rack up points!

[h3][b]Unlimited Stages[/b][/h3]
Load your own tracks into the game and watch as your favourite tunes become new levels.
Rock and Pop tunes will provide particularly challenging stages! The number of stages si only limited by the size of your music library!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/1a514cf69e837759a7d3f149d11ae883e189cdea.png[/img]

[h3][b]Show me, Show you.[/b][/h3]
Sound Art has a Live Show mode where you can stream and show off your playstyle to a crowd.
With VRM avatar support, with a simple file swap you can play as your favourite avatar.
Also if you're streaming on youtube or twitch, viewer reactions will appear in game so you can connect with your audience!
SoundArt isn't just a game for the one with the VR headset on, it's also for the viewers.

[h3][b]Indie Game Collab Tunes Included![/b][/h3]
